data.text: I’m on board with a shared limit, Emma. But I’d suggest 16 tons each this month: we’d leave 20, so next month starts at either 100 or 40 rather than 100 or 20. That gives up $2,000 each now for a better cushion if replenishment fails. Going forward, let’s agree on whole-ton quotas based on the actual stock, always leaving at least 5, and rotate any extra tons fairly. I’ll commit to 16 if everyone agrees. John, would you support that?
